next.title: Your next step this week
next.intro: Four things picked for you this week. Each one opens with a tap.
next.drive: A drive you can register for, closes {{date}}
next.why: Picked from your roadmap, the drives and jobs you are eligible for, and the alumni who match you. A new one comes every Monday evening.
next.none: Nothing to suggest yet. Follow a roadmap or complete your profile, and next week's Next Step will have something for you.

peers.intro: Seniors guide juniors here: final-years as peer mentors, and every first-year gets a senior buddy for their first month.
peers.eligibleOffer: You have a verified offer in your final years, so you can mentor juniors.
peers.eligibleNominated: Faculty nominated you, so you can mentor juniors.
peers.notEligible: Peer mentoring opens to final-years with a verified offer, or to students faculty nominate.
peers.mentorSwitchBody: Juniors can send you up to three requests a week for a quick chat or a short call.

buddy.title: Senior buddy

item.hello: Say hello and swap how you like to talk
item.campus: Show the campus: labs, library, clubs, where to eat
item.study: Talk about subjects, notes and how exams work
item.plan: Make a plan for the semester and what to try next

buddy.noneFirstYear: First-years get a senior buddy in their first week. Yours will show here.
buddy.noneSenior: Volunteer below and you will be paired with a first-year.
buddy.volunteerBody: Up to {{n}} first-years at a time, for their first four weeks.
buddy.volunteerNo: Senior buddies are verified students past their first year.

circles.intro: Communities for your batch, branch, clubs and interests. What is posted in a circle is seen by its members only.

none.mine: You are not in any circle yet
none.discover: No circles to join right now

circles.createBody: It is active straight away. Members see its posts, questions and events.
circles.proposeBody: Staff approve it before anyone can join. You will lead it.
circles.proposed: Sent. Staff will review your circle.
circles.name: Name

circle.askHint: Questions are checked by a moderator, like every question.
circle.asked: Sent. It appears once a moderator approves it.
circle.waiting: This circle is waiting for staff approval.
circle.joinToSee: Join to see what the circle posts, asks and plans.

groups.title: Study groups
groups.intro: Study a subject together: {{min}} to {{max}} classmates, a shared list of questions, a time to meet and quizzes from the study assistant.
groups.newBody: Pick a subject. The group forms when {{min}} people join, and holds up to {{max}}.
groups.subject: Subject
groups.name: Group name
groups.noneBody: Start one for a subject and classmates can join.
groups.formingBody: The group starts when {{n}} people have joined.
groups.noQuestions: Add the questions you want to go through together.
groups.noQuizShared: Run /quiz in the study assistant, then share it here for everyone to take.
groups.shareBody: Pick one of your recent quizzes. Members see the questions; the answers show after they take it.
groups.openSubject: Open the subject to make one

voice.askBody: Speak your question, up to a minute. We write it out; you can fix the text before or after it is published.
voice.answerBody: Speak your answer, up to a minute. It is published once it is written out, and you can fix the text.
voice.ready: Recorded. Send it, or record again.
voice.keepBody: Readers can play it next to the text. Otherwise it is deleted once written out.
voice.askSent: Sent. Check the text in My questions once it is written out.
voice.answerSent: Sent. Your answer appears once it is written out.
voice.unsupported: This browser cannot record. Type your question instead.
voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or type instead.
voice.failed: The recording did not work. Try again, or type instead.
voice.fixBody: Correct any words the transcript got wrong.
voice.question: Question

admin.intro: First-years are matched with a senior buddy every day; peer mentors are final-years with a verified offer or students you nominate.
admin.matched: Matched {{n}}; {{waiting}} still waiting for a volunteer
admin.matchDaily: Matching also runs once a day. Counts under five show as “<5”.
admin.nominateBody: For students without a verified offer who you think can guide juniors.
admin.nominated: Nominated. They can turn peer mentoring on.
admin.circlesIntro: Students and alumni propose circles; approve the ones that fit. What is posted in a circle is moderated like everything else.
